_performanceFloorNote: categories:performance is held to 0.9, not the 1.0 seo/accessibility floor, because this repo has already measured that a GitHub-hosted runner is not the reference machine: ci.yml's perf job records every timing at roughly 2.8x a reference laptop (MOCK_KNIGHT_PERF_SCALE: 3) with deterministic assertions unaffected. Lighthouse's performance category is CPU-throughput-sensitive by design, so it inherits that same variance; seo and accessibility are checklist-based and do not move with runner speed. 0.9 is still a real gate for a site whose only JavaScript is a few dozen lines, not a rubber stamp.
